messages.text:
Hi 
My name is Sanimol and I am originally from Kerala, South India. I am currently living in Toowong, Brisbane and studying my Master's degree at QUT.
I am looking for accommodation suitable for a couple. At the moment, my husband is in India waiting for his visa approval. He is an engineer by profession, and I am a registered nurse.
We are responsible, friendly, and quiet people.
We do not smoke or drink alcohol and we
respect a peaceful living environment.
If the property is still available, I would be happy
to arrange a time for an inspection. Please feel
free to contact me by message or phone.
Thank you for your time and consideration.
Kind regards, 
Sanimol KM
